cohort: This guideline provides recommendations for pregnant women, specifically those with singleton or multiple pregnancies, at risk for or experiencing preterm labor or delivery.
finding: The guideline outlines the prevalence, risk factors (prior PTD, short cervix), and recommended prevention and management strategies for preterm labor and delivery in Turkey, emphasizing individualized care based on gestational age and specific risk factors.
gest_age: 20 0/7-36 6/7 weeks of pregnancy (for PTD); before 32nd gestational week (for short cervix definition); 16th-36th gestational weeks (for progesterone recommendations); management depends on gestational age.
